verdict.rationale: Vercel Agent is documented as a built-in AI assistant that draws on project context, deployments, logs, metrics, and configuration to generate insights, investigate issues, review code, and suggest/take approved actions, plus separate framework-aware monitoring insights across apps and AI workflows. This is first-party 'AI-generated insights from your data inside the product,' not just an external chat tool. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evaluation of the quality or accuracy of Vercel Agent's insights, and confirmation it's out of beta/broadly available rather than limited to Pro/Enterprise public beta.
